description_sq:
Shitet Toke Are me siperfaqe fizike 1200 m2 ne Qender te Surrelit ne Rrugen Kryesore
Toka eshte e pajisur me Certifikate pronesie.
Pozicionimi i saj ofron mundesi te shumta zhvillimi kjo per arsye te infrastruktures rrugore e cila lidh te gjitha akset e rrugeve kryesore te Tiranes .
description_en: Land for sale with a physical surface of 1200 m2 in the center of Surreli on the main street. The land is equipped with a certificate of ownership. Its positioning offers numerous development opportunities due to the road infrastructure that connects all the axes of the main roads of Tirana.
